sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October (15:00), looking to bounce back from their most recent loss and avenge a penalty shootout defeat to Alsager in a cup competition last week. The league leaders then face Cheadle Heath Nomads away on Saturday 10 October (15:00), with both teams looking to improve their form heading into that encounter.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town make their first ever trip to Dawley Town on Saturday 3 October (15:00) in a fixture that sees the in-form hosts looking to continue their momentum. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall on Saturday 3 October (15:00) in a key top-half clash. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th) visit Wednesfield Community (9th) on Saturday 3 October (15:00) in what both clubs are treating as a derby day encounter. Bilston Town face Foley Meir at home on Saturday 3 October (15:00), while on the road, Allscott Heath travel to Crewe aiming to extend their run of victories, and Cheadle Heath Nomads welcome Telford Town to their stadium. Market Drayton Town host New Mills on Saturday 3 October (15:00) as both teams seek to climb the table. Shawbury United visit Brereton Social on Saturday 3 October (15:00), with Shawbury desperate to end a run of six consecutive losses. On Wednesday 7 October (19:45), Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture. The following Saturday 10 October (15:00), Allscott Heath host Sandbach's opponents Brereton Social, Alsager Town welcome Shawbury United, Barnton travel to Dawley Town, Bilston Town face Crewe, Market Drayton Town host Widnes Town, Stafford Town host Wednesfield Community, Telford Town visit New Mills, and Sandbach visit Cheadle Heath Nomads.
